meta.title: e-clinic · Clinic management for primary care
meta.description: Registration, queue, electronic medical records, pharmacy, cashier and reports for primary care clinics, in one system in the browser. Try the demo clinic or register yours.

hero.title: One flow for every patient, from registration to going home.
hero.lead: Clinic management for primary care, from one clinic to many branches: registration, queue, electronic medical records, pharmacy, cashier and owner reports. Shared by the whole staff, right in the browser.
hero.demoNote: The demo clinic holds sample data. Sign in as front desk, doctor, pharmacist, cashier or owner without registering.
hero.visualAlt: The e-clinic queue screen and the owner's home on a phone.
hero.boardIntro: Try it yourself: register as a patient and follow your own visit from desk to desk.

board.title: Today's queue
board.label: Sample queue board: patients move from the waiting room to the exam room, pharmacy, cashier, then home.

steps.waiting: The front desk registers you; a queue number is issued and the nurse records your vitals.
steps.in_exam: The doctor calls you, writes SOAP and the diagnosis, then sends the prescription, paperless.
steps.to_pharmacy: The prescription is already waiting at the pharmacy; medicines come from the batch closest to expiry.
steps.to_cashier: The invoice is complete when you arrive: consultation and medicines, ready to pay.
steps.done: Done. Five desks, no paper, and the owner sees it live on their phone.

journey.title: One visit, five desks
journey.lead: Every screen shows the same patient. When the doctor signs the record, the prescription appears at the pharmacy; when the medicines are handed over, the invoice appears at the cashier. No paper passed around.

waiting.title: Patients register and join the queue at once
waiting.body: The front desk finds the patient by name, NIK, phone or MRN, picks the clinic and doctor, and a queue number is issued. The doctor's quota for the day is enforced. A patient can be called only once their vitals are recorded.
waiting.alt: Queue screen: patients in the waiting room, exam room, pharmacy and cashier.

in_exam.title: Doctors write the record without switching screens
in_exam.body: SOAP, ICD-10 diagnoses found by their Indonesian disease names, procedures, prescriptions, and sick and referral letters. Once signed, the record is locked and corrections are kept as amendments.
in_exam.alt: Exam screen: SOAP notes, vitals, diagnoses and the completeness checklist.

to_pharmacy.title: The prescription reaches the pharmacy before the patient does
to_pharmacy.body: Medicines come from the batch closest to expiry, are recorded on the stock card, and their labels are ready to print. Compounded powders and capsules are supported. When stock runs short, an item is marked not given and is not charged.
to_pharmacy.alt: Dispensing screen: the batch and expiry date of each medicine, with a label preview.

to_cashier.title: The invoice is complete when the patient reaches the cashier
to_cashier.body: Consultation, procedures, consumables and medicines are added automatically. Pay by cash, QRIS or transfer; BPJS patients pay nothing. Every discount has a reason, and a paid invoice can only be voided, never edited.
to_cashier.alt: Cashier screen: the patient waiting to pay, today's transactions and payment methods.

done.title: The owner follows the day from their phone
done.body: Revenue, patient count and who is still in the clinic, live. Revenue, doctor fee, profit and loss, and top-ten-diseases reports download to Excel.
done.alt: The owner's home on a phone: today's revenue, patient count and a 14-day trend.

access.title: Who sees what
access.lead: Access is checked on the server and in the database, not just hidden from the screen. Each clinic's data is kept apart in the database itself.
access.caption: Access by role

export.body: Every patient and transaction can be exported to Excel at any time.

backup.body: The database is backed up every night, encrypted, to a separate location.

audit.body: The activity log records who changed master, financial and operational data, and when.

idle.body: Sessions end on their own when a computer sits idle. The clinic sets the timeout.

integrations.body: In progress. Visits, diagnoses and medicines will be sent in the background, with a delivery status screen.

browser.body: Runs in the browser on the clinic's computers and the owner's phone. Needs an internet connection.

migrate.q: Can we bring our existing data?
migrate.a: Yes. Medicines, tariffs and suppliers import from Excel templates available in the app.

offline.q: What if the internet goes down?
offline.a: e-clinic needs an internet connection. Data lives on the server, so nothing is lost if a computer turns off, and work continues as soon as the connection is back.

setup.q: What do we set up after registering?
setup.a: A checklist on the home screen guides six steps: clinic profile, clinics and consultation fees, doctors, practice schedules, medicines, and the rest of the staff.

domain.q: Can we use our own domain?
domain.a: Every clinic gets its own address, like sehat.{domain}. Your own domain is being prepared.

branches.q: Can we use it for several branches?
branches.a: Yes. The owner opens a new branch from the company overview; clinics, tariffs, medicines and patient records are there at once, while its queue, stock and cashier are its own. A branch no longer in use can be archived without losing its data.

closing.title: Look around the demo clinic first, or register yours now.
closing.lead: Registering takes two minutes. You then sign in as the owner, and a checklist guides the rest.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: Check the address, or go back home.

branches.title: One company, many branches
branches.lead: Patients, staff and the price list are managed once for the company. Each branch runs its own queue, so a patient in Depok is never called in Bogor.
branches.ownQueue: Its own queue, stock and cashier
